name: file-connector
description: Let Hermes read files from disk in one call: PDF and images (scanned pages and pictures through OCR), Outlook .msg and .eml e-mails with their attachments, Word, Excel (.xlsx and .xls), PowerPoint, HTML and text. Reads an attachment in place, saves attachments to a folder, renders PDF pages and pictures (or one region of them) for a vision model, reads and safely unpacks .zip archives, and tabulates a folder of letters or documents. Read-only; a page with a text layer never leaves the machine.
